[Pedagogy review · Suggestion · extension · pf-27a9edce47]
Append follow-ups to p7-q5-e: (i) Integrate (x−3)² using the linear-inner-function rule. Answer: (x−3)³/3+C. (ii) Expand (x−3)³/3. Answer: x³/3−3x²+9x−9. (iii) What constant must be added to obtain x³/3−3x²+9x? Answer: 9. (iv) Explain why both methods give the same general primitive. Answer: the constant difference is absorbed into C.
